lead: Counselling stations: a simulated patient needs information and a decision. Use one frame for all of them and check her understanding.
f: Introduce · establish what she knows · facts in 2–3 chunks without jargon · options · ICE · check understanding (teach-back) · plan · leaflets and follow-up

Break the news (SPIKES) · labour starts within 3 wk in 85% · DIC in about 30% after 3–4 wk · induction preferred: mifepristone 200 mg, then misoprostol 36–48 h later · CS only for a usual obstetric reason · seeing and holding the baby, her choice · cabergoline 1 mg · anti-D if Rh-negative · investigations · review at 6 wk

sc: IUFD at 34 wk, well → Induction with mifepristone then misoprostol

f: Cardiac output rises about 40% · joint clinic · fetal echo at 20–22 wk · warfarin: LMWH in weeks 6–12 (and from 36 wk) · labour sitting up, epidural, short 2nd stage · oxytocin slowly, no ergometrine · HDU after birth

sc: Mitral stenosis, soft uterus after birth → Avoid ergometrine

f: Fit-free 2 years ideal · avoid valproate (switch before pregnancy) · folic acid 5 mg from 3 months before · never stop drugs suddenly · baby vitamin K 1 mg

sc: On valproate, planning a pregnancy → Switch drug; folic acid 5 mg first

f: LAM 98% if all 3 rules · progestogen methods any time while breastfeeding · copper IUD within 48 h or after 4 wk · no method needed before day 21 · combined pill not before 6 months if breastfeeding
Diet, glucose diary (fasting < 5.3, 1 h after meals < 7.8 mmol/L) · insulin into the abdomen or thigh, change the site · keep insulin cool · hypoglycaemia: oral glucose, recheck in 15 min
VBAC success 72–75% · scar rupture about 0.5% · deliver in hospital, continuous CTG · two or more previous CS: repeat CS at 39 wk
